When you absolutely need something destroyed from a safe distance. The §6Railgun§f launches high-velocity projectiles that deal 200 HP damage to anything in range.

Vanilla crafting: Tracking Circuit, Control Circuit Board, structure machine, Item IO Circuit Board, steel fans, and copper coils. Uses §6railgun slugs§f as ammunition (iron, steel, or titanium ingots in a shaped recipe). Right-click to set target, fire to launch.

The targeting GUI shows a red crosshair when the target is in line of sight. For boss fights, aim for the head for 2x damage. The railgun is also the key tool for breaking asteroid chunks in mining missions.

§cWARNING:§f Each shot eats 50,000 RF. That's more than most reactors produce in a tick. Pair with a Fusion Reactor or Draconic Evolution energy core. Always carry 64+ slugs.
